 Coleman receives warm welcome back to Calgary 
 Wild forward played five seasons for Flames 
 By 
 Anna Kulesa 
 @akulesa_ 
 NHL.com Staff Writer 
 October 23, 2026 
 Link copied 
 Calgary Flames fans lit up when they saw Blake Coleman on Thursday.
 The Minnesota Wild forward received a standing ovation in his first game back at Scotiabank Saddledome in Calgary since being traded in July.
 During a stoppage of play in the first period, the Flames played a video tribute featuring highlights of Coleman’s time with the team on the arena scoreboard.
 Flames fans got on their feet and cheered loudly for the veteran forward as he saluted the crowd.
 Nothing but love for Blake Coleman in his first game back in Calgary! ❤️ pic.twitter.com/bEBSq8wWek 
— NHL (@NHL) October 23, 2026 
 The Flames also shared the video tribute on social media.
 Welcome back, Colesy ❤️ Thank you for everything! pic.twitter.com/sRfcHr1MQD 
— Calgary Flames (@NHLFlames) October 23, 2026 
 Coleman played five of his 11 NHL seasons with the Flames from 2021-26. He was traded to the Wild in exchange for forward Jake Middleton  and future draft picks.
